name: 4-chlorobenzoate to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine
summary: A 11-step route from 4-chlorobenzoate to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine zwitterion, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: tRNA (cytosine(38)-C(5))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: cytidine(38) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methylcytidine(38) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (cytidine(34)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: cytidine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: pikromycin synthase
reactions.equation: 10-deoxymethymycin + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + O2 + 2 H(+) = neomethymycin + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + H2O

reactions.name: pikromycin synthase
reactions.equation: 10-deoxymethymycin + 4 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 O2 + 4 H(+) = novamethymycin + 4 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 H2O

reactions.name: 6 isopentenyl diphosphate + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = all-trans-nonaprenyl diphosp...
reactions.equation: 6 isopentenyl diphosphate + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = all-trans-nonaprenyl diphosphate + 6 diphosphate

reactions.name: tRNA(Ser) (uridine(44)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(44) in tRNA(Ser) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methyluridine(44) in tRNA(Ser) + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (guanine(10)-N(2))-dimethyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(10) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(2)-dimethylguanosine(10) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (guanine(10)-N(2))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(10) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(2)-methylguanosine(10) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (guanine(26)-N(2))-dimethyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: acyl-lipid (n+3)-(Z)-desaturase (ferredoxin)
reactions.equation: a (9Z)-octadecenoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + O2 + 2 H(+) = a (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 H2O
